mapper.sql: select disease_id, disease_name, dept_id, is_deleted, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, sort_num,diseases_groups_id from research_diseases
mapper.select: select disease_id, disease_name, dept_id from research_diseases where is_deleted='0'

select g.disease_id, g.disease_name, g.dept_id, g.sort_num from research_diseases g inner join research_info ri on g.disease_id=ri.disease_type_id inner join sys_dept d on ri.dept_id=d.dept_id where g.is_deleted='0' and d.del_flag=0 and ri.del_flag=0 and (ri.research_status = 1 or ri.research_status = 0) and d.dept_id = #{deptId} and ri.dept_id = #{deptId} and g.disease_name like concat('%', #{diseaseName},'%') GROUP BY g.disease_id

select g.disease_id, g.disease_name, g.dept_id, g.sort_num from research_diseases g inner join research_info ri on g.disease_id=ri.disease_type_id and (ri.research_status = 1 or ri.research_status = 0) inner join sys_dept d on ri.dept_id=d.dept_id
INNER JOIN ( select user_id,research_id from research_user_role where user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY user_id,research_id ) ru on ri.id=ru.research_id
where g.is_deleted='0' and d.del_flag=0 and ri.del_flag=0 and g.disease_name like concat('%', #{diseaseName},'%') GROUP BY g.disease_id

and d.del_flag='0' and d.dept_type = '2'
${params.dataScope} order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

select d.dept_id,d.dept_name,ri.research_status,count(ri.id) as num from sys_dept d LEFT JOIN research_diseases rd on rd.dept_id=d.dept_id and rd.is_deleted='0' inner join research_info ri on ri.disease_type_id=rd.disease_id and ri.del_flag='0' inner join sys_user su on su.user_name=ri.create_by
and (ri.id in (select research_id from research_user_role where user_id = #{userId}) or su.user_id = #{userId})
where d.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY d.dept_id,d.dept_name,ri.research_status
